description: Community-built read-only Nockchain access: balances, payment verification, blocks, node health.
name: io.github.winter0x/nockchain-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated host:port list that replaces the default endpoint pool. Prefix an entry with tls:// or plain:// to override the scheme.
environmentVariables.name: NOCKCHAIN_ENDPOINTS

environmentVariables.description: Reject an endpoint whose chain state is older than this. Defaults to 900.
environmentVariables.name: NOCKCHAIN_MAX_STALENESS_SECONDS

environmentVariables.description: Reject an endpoint trailing the best height in the pool by more than this. Defaults to 3.
environmentVariables.name: NOCKCHAIN_MAX_HEIGHT_LAG
